text:
deploy-bot: Rollout live: v1.15.4 -> prod-usw2. Canary 10%. Rollout ID rl_f9a2. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/postdeploy-smoke.

mike: Quick note: synthetic heartbeat for summary-route showed a short-lived p95 blip at ~02:14 UTC affecting only long-context samples. No 5xxs, p50 unchanged.

tara: Any idea whether it's model startup or scheduling?

mike: Short traces show brief queue-wait spikes and one KV miss for a 2k-token prompt. Traffic slice ~1.7% of canary.

infra: We can apply a short conditional rule to route long-context requests back to previous model variant to avoid user impact while we warm caches. Proposed rule duration 20m.

sre-oncall: Agree. Set pager to ignore p95 alerts for this rollout window but escalate on 5xx > 0.5% or error-rate delta > 1%.

qa: Can someone run the long-context smoke payload before/after change? I'll paste curl: 
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('a'*2000)")
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/summary-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

qa: Pre-rule smoke: TIME:1.94s STATUS:200 (p95 baseline ~0.48s normally)

infra: Applying route-rule:
```bash
redwoodctl route rule add --route summary-route --match "tokens>1024" --model redwood-summary-v1.13 --duration 20m --reason "postdeploy long-context p95 blip"
```

deploy-bot: Rule added: summary-route long-context -> redwood-summary-v1.13 for 20m by infra. Audit:audit_0c1e.

qa: Post-rule smoke: TIME:0.52s STATUS:200. Good.

mike: I'll kick off a focused warmup for the new model variant (prefill large docs) and capture perf samples. If warmup brings sustained p95 < 0.8s over 10m, we will remove the rule and resume normal rollout.

infra: Note: rule auto-expires in 20m. Extend if troubleshooting takes longer.

sre-oncall: Monitoring set. If 5xx spikes, escalate.

tara: I'll add a note to the rollout artifacts and release notes: "temporary tokens>1024 route-rule applied to summary-route due to postdeploy latency blip; warmup in progress."

mike: Will post warmup progress here in ~7m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: artifacts for rl_f9a2 -> artifacts.redwood/rl_f9a2/.

qa: Closing this thread if stable for 15m.
